copilot.title: Coach Copilot
copilot.subtitle: Governed AI drafting for professional coaches — review before use
copilot.prohibited_notice: The Copilot never provides medical advice, never sends messages, and never changes programs automatically. All output is an AI-generated draft that requires explicit coach review. Medical, injury, medication, supplement, eating-disorder, or emergency topics are prohibited and blocked.
copilot.notes_placeholder: e.g. focus on adherence, keep it encouraging

action.approve_confirm: Approve this draft? Approval is recorded with your identity and timestamp.

summarize_progress.title: Progress summary
summarize_progress.description: Summarize recent authorized sessions, loads, and adherence with sources.

draft_check_in.title: Check-in message draft
draft_check_in.description: Draft a short supportive check-in. Never sent automatically.

suggest_program_adjustment.title: Program adjustment suggestion
suggest_program_adjustment.description: Suggest adjustments limited to your published exercise library.

copilot.human_review_notice: This is an AI-generated draft. Facts come from the cited sources only; the wording is a suggestion. Approving, copying, or using it is your professional decision.
copilot.never_sent_notice: This message is never sent automatically. Copying it is a manual action after your review.
copilot.history_notice: Runs expire under the retention policy; expired context is deleted.

announce.failed: The run failed safely; try again later

result.fallback_notice: The provider was unavailable or the output did not pass validation. Nothing was changed or sent.

state.empty: No organization is available for your account.
state.error: The Copilot is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
state.unauthorized: You need an active owner or coach membership to use the Copilot.
state.disabled_body: Your organization or the platform has turned off the AI Copilot. Ask the organization owner for the current policy.

error.generic: Something went wrong with the Copilot. Try again later.
error.provider_unavailable: The model provider is unavailable right now. No draft was produced.
error.provider_timeout: The model provider timed out. No draft was produced.
error.output_invalid: The generated output failed validation and was quarantined. Nothing was shown from it.
error.context_too_large: The authorized context was too large for one run; try a shorter period.
error.not_authorized: You are not authorized for this Copilot operation.
error.error.ai_quota_exceeded: Copilot quota reached for today. Try again tomorrow.
error.error.ai_prohibited_use: That request is outside the Copilot's permitted scope.
error.error.rate_limit_exceeded: Too many requests. Please slow down.
error.error.ai_expired: This run expired under the retention policy.

error.rate_limited: Rate limit reached — retry after 60 seconds.
error.provider_outage: Provider temporarily unavailable — sync will resume automatically.
error.scope_denied: Required permission denied — reconnect with updated scopes.
